summary: Li Bang International Corporation Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held April 30, 2026. Shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital from $31.505 million to $35 million, primarily by adding 349.5 million class B ordinary shares, and adopted corresponding amended articles. They also approved a share capital reduction and reorganization to reduce par value from $0.01 to $0.00001 via cancellation of paid-up capital, subdivide authorized unissued shares, and transfer the resulting credit to a distributable reserve. These are routine corporate housekeeping items involving capital structure adjustments, not a special situation event.
